newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee slips on RBI dollar purchases.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee slips on RBI dollar purchases.

text.p: The Indian rupee weakened against the dollar in late morning deals on Monday on Reserve Bank of India (RBI) spot-dollar purchases, dealers said.
They said the rupee slipped to 35.765/775 per dollar from opening quotes of 35.745/755.
"The RBI has just come in and is buying dollars," said a dealer. "They (RBI) bought dollars at 35.7625 and it looks like they are ready to buy at higher levels also."
He said trade was done at 35.7725.
In latest deals, the dollar was quoted 35.762/772 rupees.
In the forward market, the rupee was steady in range-bound trade against the dollar as demand and supply were well-matched, dealers said.
November-delivery dollars were quoted at a premium of 87/89 paise in latest deals against weekend closing quotes of 88/90.
